paite: Tate aw, pa hilhna za un, theihsiamna thei ding in limsak un.
heading: Pilna Phattuamnate
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

paite: Thugin hoihtak ka hon pe ngal a; ka dan taisan kei un.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

paite: Ka pa a ding in tapa ka hi a, ka nu mitmuh a nunnem leh ithuaipen ka hi.
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

paite: Huan ahon sinsak a, ka kiang ah, na lungtang in ka thute lenden hen; ka thupiakte zui inla, huchi in hing in.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

paite: Pilna nei in, theihsiamna nei in; mangngilh ke'n, ka kam a thute a kipan lunglel ke'n.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

paite: Huai mangngilh ke'nla, nang ahon hawi ding a; amah it inla, ama'n ahon kem ding hi.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

paite: Pilna thil thupipen ahi; huaiziak in pilna la in; ahi, na muhsa tengteng toh theihsiamna la in.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

paite: Amah pahtawi inla, ama'n nang hon kaisangsak ding; pahtawina ahon tun dia, amah na kawi lai in.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

paite: Na lu a ding in kilawmna kizepna ahon pe dia; kilawmna lallukhu nang ahon pe ding hi.
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

paite: Aw ka tapa, ka gente za inla, sang in; huchi in na damsung kumte atam ding hi.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

paite: Pilna lampi ah ka hon kisinsakta a; lampi tangte ah ka hon pita hi.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

paite: Na pai chiang in, na kalsuante haksa in a-om kei ding a; na taileh, na kisui puk kei ding.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

paite: Hilhna kiptak in len in; paisak ke'n; amah vom in; amah lah na hinna ahi ngal a.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

paite: Migiloute lampi ah lut ke'n; gilou mite lampi ah pai ke'n.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

paite: Pel inla, akiang ah pai ke'n; kiheisan inla, pai vengveng in.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

paite: Poi akhoih kei ngal uleh, a- ihmu ngal kei ua; kuahiam apuksak kei uleh, a-ihmutna uh lakmang in a-om hi.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

paite: Gitlouhna tanghou lah ane ngal ua, hiamgamna uain adawn uhi.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

paite: Himahleh midiktatte lampi khovak tung bang ahi, sun laitak a nisa bang a tangpha semsem.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

paite: Migiloute lampi khomial bang ahi; akisuihna uh athei kei uhi.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

paite: Ka tapa, ka thute limsak in; ka gente ah na bildoh in.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

paite: Na mitte a kipan amaute lamang ke'n; na lungtang lak ah vom in.
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

paite: Amau mute a ding in hinna ahi ngal ua, asa uh a ding in damna.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

paite: Thanopna tengteng toh na lungtang kem in; huai a kipan lah hinna tui nakte aluang ngal a.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

paite: Nang a kipan kam hoih lou koihmang inla, nang a kipan in muk kilawmloute gamlapi ah koih in.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

paite: Na mitte'n tangtak in en uhenla, na etna na ma ah tang hen.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

paite: Na khe lampi pheisak inla, huan na lampi tengteng hihkip in omsak in.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

paite: Na khut taklam hiam veilam hiam ah pial ke'n; gilou lampi ah pai ke'n.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
